title: front core input (shared base)
description: The one validated input document of a front core's run (station-loop.md section 4). The shared base the four front cores start from; each core's lane adds its own fields under `station`, and nothing else. Every object is closed: an unknown key is refused, never ignored, so a typo cannot become a silent default. `input_version` is the bump path a closed schema needs. What the schema cannot say is enforced in code (station_core/inputs.py): the workspace and the staging home are existing absolute directories, and the run directory is absolute and lies inside neither.

input_version.description: the version of this input shape; a reader that does not know it refuses the input

run_id.description: this run's own id, single-use, one path segment

workspace.description: absolute path of the directory the core reads and writes; a git work tree root when the core writes into a repository

staging.description: optional: absolute path of the named non-repository home, passed resolved and never expanded by a script; precon and architect write there when no repository owns the idea

run_dir.description: absolute path of this run's directory, outside the workspace and outside the staging home

report_only.description: when true the run writes nothing to the workspace, the staging home or the records log, and its result says so

owner_word.description: the owner's word in this run, the one source of a reader request's `authorized` flag: the readers rows the owner named, and his words verbatim. Never carried over from another run.

rows.description: the readers roster row ids the owner's words name

invocation.description: facts about the session this run happens in, filled by the adapter's invocation.py, never typed by the executor

harness.description: the harness this run is driven from

caller.description: who asked for the run: `user` on a direct request, or the station that called this one

mode.description: `direct` when a person asked, `station` when another station drove it

session_id.description: the session this run happens in, as the adapter READ it from the harness's own record; the recorded answer names the same session

station.description: the fields the core's own lane adds (slice 2); closed and empty in the frame
